lists.title: Young kids — basics
lists.description: Sensible defaults for young children: hides videos YouTube itself marks as not family-safe, and needs a parent's OK for live streams, very long videos, and news.

lists.title: Scary and horror
lists.description: Hides horror, gore and creepypasta; needs a parent's OK for spooky games and mascot-horror (Poppy Playtime, FNAF and similar) that target kids.

lists.title: Violence and weapons
lists.description: Hides graphic violence; needs a parent's OK for fights, guns and true crime. (Nerf and toy guns also need an OK — allow them yourself if you're fine with them.)

lists.title: Mature and adult content
lists.description: Hides sexual and adult content; needs a parent's OK for alcohol, drugs, vaping and swearing in titles.

lists.title: Dangerous challenges and pranks
lists.description: Hides known dangerous viral challenges; needs a parent's OK for prank videos.

lists.title: Gambling and scams
lists.description: Hides free-Robux/V-Bucks scams; needs a parent's OK for gambling, loot boxes, case openings and betting.

lists.title: Brainrot and meme spam
lists.description: Needs a parent's OK for "brainrot" meme content (Skibidi, Italian brainrot, sigma/rizz edits and similar). Optional — choose it if you want less of this.
